sudo tcpdump -n -i any '(udp port 53) or (tcp SYN && !ACK && not 127/8 && not 10.0.2.2)' plus 'ss -tunp' socket sampling every 2s (187 samples), 18:41:59Z-18:48:27Z; operator ready 18:43:27Z, so 300s of idle production runtime

summary: This is the production-mode repair the independent grader asked for (EI-24710158395281724: the earlier capture was a README dev boot, where telemetry-flush never forwards). The packaged Tauri shell spawns the operator sidecar with NODE_ENV=production (papercusp-desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs .env("NODE_ENV","production")), and /proc/<pid>/environ of every serve.mjs process confirms NODE_ENV=production, PAPERCUSP_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILE=public, HOME=/tmp/r11home3 (plus a leftover earlier fresh-profile instance, HOME=/tmp/r11home2, also production). /api/health returned {ok:true, sha:3c1ed9a1, version 0.0.25} at the start (18:43:27Z) and end (18:48:27Z) of the window. With the operator up for 300s and no opt-in, the only outbound TCP SYN was the control curl (104.20.23.154:443); the only DNS names were the two control names and the VM's own hostname papercusp-testvm, which was answered on loopback (0 of 372 of those packets on enp0s2). The ss samples show no non-loopback connection owned by any Papercusp process; the only established remote socket was curl (pid 65220). The telemetry target in this build is POSTHOG_PUBLIC_DEFAULTS.host = https://flags.papercuspai.com (packages/operator-core/lib/posthog-public-defaults.ts); it was never looked up, and no ~/.papercusp/posthog.json discovery file exists. Disclosed attempts that do NOT count: the GUI AppImage alone starts no sidecar (it waits for the Server bundle), and a v2 capture (~/r18/r11prod2) was contaminated by OS apt/launchpad traffic triggered by the package install itself.

assertions.evidence: sidecar-env.txt: every serve.mjs process has NODE_ENV=production and PAPERCUSP_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILE=public; health.json and health-end.json: ok:true sha 3c1ed9a1.

tcpdump.txt: 770 lines; one outbound SYN, 10.0.2.15:57010 > 104.20.23.154:443 at 18:45:57Z = the control curl (ss: users:(("curl",pid=65220))). DNS names: example.com, r11prod3-positive-control.example.com (controls) and papercusp-testvm (loopback only).
flags.papercuspai.com (posthog-public-defaults.ts:29) appears in no DNS query; posthog-discovery.txt: no posthog.json.
ss-samples.txt: 187 samples; the only non-loopback established socket belongs to curl; Papercusp processes show only listeners.
control.txt: curl 200; both control names and the control SYN appear in tcpdump.txt and ss-samples.txt, so a telemetry request would have been seen.
os-updaters-running.txt is empty: no apt/packagekit/snap/update-notifier/fwupd unit running during the capture.
